title: Dunjunz, official flippy disc (Bug-Byte, 1987), Model B side
notes: Dun1 and Coder, exported with oaknut-disc from the Model B side of HFE flux captures of the 1987 flippy disc made by VectorEyes for the beeb_hfe archive of original discs (catalogued as Bug Byte, Dunjunz, variant 1, with identical copies owned by pumpkin and ip) and passed to the project by the stardot user Pernod; the files are byte-identical to the NVG archive's Dunjunz.zip. Dun1 (&2000-&7FFF, the figures above) holds the whole game. Coder (&5000-&59AF, 2480 bytes, exec &5000; SHA-256 2809c2aca27673963f795033190d0668c59789161483f173b331a8b468ae1775) is run for every level: it reloads Dun1, loads the level, copies &3000-&473F down to &08C0-&1FFF and one of two images of &0400-&07FF (keyboard only, or with a joystick handler) into place, and starts the game. The listing saves both files.
